done.why: I had seen a handful of rooms and had a memorable run-in with the man at the cliff. I stopped there. I wasn't stuck, and I didn't reach an ending.

about: An underground cave world with a dream-like frame story about a final test. I explored passages, a sunlit cliff and a shore. A man at the top of a cliff watched me and took the chest I tied to the rope.

moments.note: Walking south into the dark warned me about a grue. I had to guess to turn on the lantern.
Taking the sword got the reply 'Who do you think you are? Arthur?'
Someone unseen at the top of the cliff reacted to what I did, and the rope twitched.
I said hello to the man above and got 'That sentence isn't one I recognize' tacked on after his reply.
I tied the chest to the rope and the man hauled it up and left me stranded. I felt tricked.
I scrambled down the cliff without being sure it was one-way, even though the text had hinted at it.

wished: Talk to the man at the cliff top and get a real answer.
Know what the final test was and what I was meant to do.
Examine the 'not a tree' thing I was told about.

lines.line: Who do you think you are? Arthur?
"That is uncommonly good of you, I do say!" He chuckles unpleasantly.
lines.why: This is where the unseen watcher showed himself, and it was a surprise.

fun.why: There were good small moments, but I saw little of the world.

engagement.why: The watching man pulled me in, but the session was short.

difficulty.why: Nothing was hard, but a few of my guesses had one-way consequences I didn't expect.

interestingness.why: The cliff man reacted to my actions in a way I didn't expect.

prose.why: The descriptions were vivid, for example the cliff oasis.
